notes: Owner: *"I like how the economy indicators are displayed first, that sort of follows our top down approach; the next set of overlays should be the Sector/Industry indicator time series and they should also work in the same way as the economic indicators."* The top-down order was already structural (the catalog drives the picker and industry sits second). This release makes the behavior identical too, via ONE implementation rather than a copy: the history splice is extracted into a shared helper, industry.js gains its own HISTORY map in the economy's shape, and industry refs now carry the same
